meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: TextMine MCP
connector.registryDescription: Search, read, and automate TextMine documents, records, workflows, integrations, and agent tasks.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.textmine.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.textmine, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer TextMine API key, for example Bearer tm_<key>. Create or request a key through agent self-service signup or TextMine support.

headers.name: X-TextMine-Application
headers.description: Optional TextMine MCP application adapter id, for example copilot-studio for Copilot Studio surfaces. Omit unless TextMine or the client setup guide requires a specific adapter.
